items_all.title: The DOJ is investigating a16z. What does this mean for venture capital?
items_all.summary: Andreessen Horowitz has two partners sitting on the boards of companies that now compete with each other: Ben Horowitz at Databricks and Martin Casado at Fivetran. Nothing too scandalous on the surface, except the Department of Justice has reportedly been investigating the arrangement for almost a year, dusting off a 112-year-old antitrust law that’s rarely used against VCs. Board conflicts aren’t exactly new, and these companies weren’t necessarily direct competitors when a16z first invested […]
items_all.summary_zh: Andreessen Horowitz 有兩位合夥人在目前相互競爭的公司董事會中任職：Databricks 的 Ben Horowitz 和 Fivetran 的 Martin Casado。表面上看，並沒有什麼太醜聞的地方，只是據報道，司法部已經對這一安排進行了近一年的調查，並重新制定了一項已有 112 年曆史的反壟斷法，該法很少用於針對風險投資公司。董事會衝突並不是什麼新鮮事，當 a16z 第一次投資時，這些公司不一定是直接競爭對手 […]

items_all.title: Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式
items_all.summary: Salesforce週四（8/20）推出Slack Code，讓企業團隊可在Slack中與AI程式代理人共同開發、檢視及修改程式碼。 Slack過去已能整合各種AI代理人，但相關功能主要用於對話及個別任務。隨著Claude Code、Devin、GitHub Copilot及ChatGPT等代理人開始處理更複雜的程式開發，開發者與AI的討論及修改過程通常只有自己看得到，其他團隊成員難以同步參與。

items_all.summary: 2026臺北國際自動化工業大展今年聚焦AI、智慧製造與工業5.0，在機器人應用方面，Nvidia近年積極推動的Physical AI成為展出的焦點，如臺達電、所羅門業者展示相關的應用發展。 過去工業用的機器人強調自動化，依照固定程式執行重複作業，Nvidia推動的Physical AI技術，強調機器人結合AI模型、視覺感知及數位孿生，使其具備理解環境、自主規畫、執行任務與持續學習能力。今年自動化展出的內容可看到3項趨勢，包括「數位孿生協助產線規畫及Physical AI落地的重要基礎，「AI Vision成為Physical AI的感知能力」，以及「工廠逐步從自動化走向自主化」。

items_all.title: Meet UPDF: A Lightweight Adobe Alternative Built for the Agentic Era
items_all.summary: PDFs are easy to read and hard to change. AI can now summarize a 90-page contract in seconds, but it still won't rewrite the source file cleanly. UPDF is built for that second half: direct editing, 14-format conversion, 38-language OCR, and ten AI agents shipped in version 2.5. The post Meet UPDF: A Lightweight Adobe Alternative Built for the Agentic Era appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: PDF 易於閱讀但難以更改。人工智慧現在可以在幾秒鐘內總結一份 90 頁的合同，但它仍然無法乾淨地重寫原始檔。 UPDF 是為後半部分而構建的：直接編輯、14 種格式轉換、38 種語言 OCR 以及 2.5 版本中提供的 10 個 AI 代理。帖子“認識 UPDF：為代理時代構建的輕量級 Adob​​e 替代方案”首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all.title: LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable
items_all.summary: LLMs don't write in a recognizable style because they can't do better. Post-training and safety guardrails sharply narrow their expressive range, argues Pangram CTO Bradley Emi. Base models without these constraints already write with far more variety. The article LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: LLMs 不以可識別的風格編寫，因為他們無法做得更好。 Pangram 技術長 Bradley Emi 認為，訓練後和安全護欄大大縮小了它們的表達範圍。沒有這些限制的基本模型已經可以編寫出更多樣的內容。文章 LLMs 可以像人類一樣寫作，但訓練後護欄使他們的文字可檢測到，首先出現在解碼器上。

items_all.title: Stop Making TUIs
items_all.summary: Stop Making TUIs Thomas Ptacek advocates for building real native user interfaces for even the smallest of personal tools, because coding agents have reduced the cost of getting a usable-enough GUI up and running to almost nothing. I wrote about my vibe-coded bandwidth and GPU monitoring macOS task bar apps back in March , and I'm still using both of those on a daily basis. I'm not habitually knocking out real UIs for my other projects yet, but I'm running out of excuses! Thomas: If you haven’t tried your hand at turning one of your 500 throwaway CLIs into a native app, you’re doing yourself a disservice. Go build a native UI. It’ll probably change the way you think. Tags: thomas-ptacek , ai , generative-ai , llms , vibe-coding , coding-agents

items_all.title: Quoting Matt Webb
items_all.summary: After I released version 1.0, I figured I would have to do the rotations myself. So I sat down with ChatGPT and I didn’t get it to write the code, but I got it to educate me. With a patient, interactive tutor, I was able to finally do what I hadn’t by reading books and asking mathematician friends – I learnt how to use quaternions just enough to make the app work. So learning doesn’t stop just because I outsource a bunch of thinking to AI. It pushes me to learn more. I like that as an outcome. — Matt Webb , Galactic Compass 2: now with new augmented reality mode Tags: matt-webb , generative-ai , chatgpt , education , ai , llms

items_all.title: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale
items_all.summary: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale Promptwatch is part of the emerging "GEO" space, for Generative Engine Optimization - the chatbot version of SEO, where companies offer tools and consulting to help your site increase its presence in replies to prompts inside tools like ChatGPT. The Promptwatch product uses automation to track responses to prompts across end-user chat products like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. They publish aggregate reports on this as part of their own content marketing strategy, which do seem to provide credible hints as to otherwise invisible design changes to those products. Their own tracking shows a notable change aligned with the GPT-5.6 rollout earlier this month: The percentage of all ChatGPT Search fanout queries that contain the site:operator, per day. The share hovered between 0.3% and 0.5% for weeks, dipped briefly to 0.15% on August 3 to 5 (consistent with a staged rollout or pre-launch experiment), then jumped to 16-17% on August 8. It's important to note that these figures only reflect the prompts for which they have automated tracking enabled. This corresponds to OpenAI's somewhat vague August 6th announcement : For Plus and Pro users, we’re updating GPT‑5.6 Sol in Chat to be more reliable with facts and provide more focused answers. Once again I am hampered by OpenAI's decision to actively obscure their system prompts, but from poking at ChatGPT I believe their latest search tool has a shape like search(query, recency, domains) rather than encouraging a site: operator directly. In a follow-up on August 18th Promptwatch repo
items_all.summary_zh: ChatGPT 搜尋現在使用 site:operator 大規模 Promptwatch 是新興“GEO”空間的一部分，用於生成引擎最佳化（SEO 的聊天機器人版本），公司提供工具和諮詢來幫助您的網站在回覆 ChatGPT 等工具內的提示時提高其存在感。 Promptwatch 產品使用自動化技術來跟蹤 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 等終端使用者聊天產品的提示響應。他們釋出了有關此問題的彙總報告，作為自己的內容營銷策略的一部分，這似乎確實為這些產品的其他隱形設計更改提供了可靠的提示。他們自己的跟蹤顯示了與本月早些時候推出的 GPT-5.6 一致的顯著變化：每天包含 site:operator 的所有 ChatGPT 搜尋扇出查詢的百分比。該份額連續數週徘徊在 0.3% 至 0.5% 之間，8 月 3 日至 5 日短暫下跌至 0.15%（與分階段推出或釋出前實驗一致），然後在 8 月 8 日躍升至 16-17%。值得注意的是，這些數字僅反映了啟用自動跟蹤的提示。這與 OpenAI's 8 月 6 日的公告相對應，有些模糊：對於 Plus 和 Pro 使用者，我們正在更新 Chat 中的 GPT‑5.6 Sol，以便更可靠地提供事實並提供更有針對性的答案。我再次受到 OpenAI's 決定主動模糊其系統提示的阻礙，但透過戳 ChatGPT，我相信他們最新的搜尋工具具有類似搜尋（查詢、新近度、域）的形狀，而不是直接鼓勵 site: 操作員。在 8 月 18 日 Promptwatch 回購協議的後續行動中

items_all.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro tops Editorial Craft benchmark with 0.97 score
items_all.summary: In a 12-task Editorial Craft evaluation of 12 AI models, OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro ranked first with a 0.97 score at $0.0091 per task. OpenAI claimed four of the top six spots, while Grok 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.8 tied at 0.93 among the leading non-OpenAI models.
items_all.summary_zh: 在對 12 個 AI 模型進行的 12 任務Editorial Craft 評估中，OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 以每項任務 0.0091 美元的 0.97 分排名第一。 OpenAI 佔據前六名中的四席，而 Grok 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.8 在領先的非 OpenAI 模型中並列，得分為 0.93。

items_all_raw.title: Stop Making TUIs
items_all_raw.summary: Stop Making TUIs Thomas Ptacek advocates for building real native user interfaces for even the smallest of personal tools, because coding agents have reduced the cost of getting a usable-enough GUI up and running to almost nothing. I wrote about my vibe-coded bandwidth and GPU monitoring macOS task bar apps back in March , and I'm still using both of those on a daily basis. I'm not habitually knocking out real UIs for my other projects yet, but I'm running out of excuses! Thomas: If you haven’t tried your hand at turning one of your 500 throwaway CLIs into a native app, you’re doing yourself a disservice. Go build a native UI. It’ll probably change the way you think. Tags: thomas-ptacek , ai , generative-ai , llms , vibe-coding , coding-agents

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Matt Webb
items_all_raw.summary: After I released version 1.0, I figured I would have to do the rotations myself. So I sat down with ChatGPT and I didn’t get it to write the code, but I got it to educate me. With a patient, interactive tutor, I was able to finally do what I hadn’t by reading books and asking mathematician friends – I learnt how to use quaternions just enough to make the app work. So learning doesn’t stop just because I outsource a bunch of thinking to AI. It pushes me to learn more. I like that as an outcome. — Matt Webb , Galactic Compass 2: now with new augmented reality mode Tags: matt-webb , generative-ai , chatgpt , education , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: GPT-5.6 Sol drives OpenAI's revenue surge as it regains ground on Anthropic
items_all_raw.summary: Since GPT-5.6 Sol launched in early July, OpenAI says revenue is up 35 percent this quarter, with enterprise revenue growing more than 50 percent. Ramp data shows OpenAI outpacing Anthropic in business API spending for the first time after Anthropic had overtaken OpenAI in quarterly revenue. The article GPT-5.6 Sol drives OpenAI's revenue surge as it regains ground on Anthropic appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 自 GPT-5.6 Sol 於 7 月初推出以來，OpenAI 表示本季度收入增長了 35%，其中企業收入增長超過 50%。斜坡資料顯示，繼 Anthropic 的季度收入超過 OpenAI 後，OpenAI 的業務 API 支出首次超過 Anthropic。文章《GPT-5.6 Sol 推動 OpenAI's 收入激增，因為它在 Anthropic 上重新站穩了腳跟》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 can now generate images without a background
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI is previewing transparent background support for GPT-Image-2 through its API. The alpha channel gets baked in during image generation, which according to OpenAI beats conventional background removal. A single parameter activates the feature. The article OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 can now generate images without a background appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: 從自動化走向自主化，Nvidia Physical AI成自動化大展焦點，臺達、所羅門大秀機器人新應用
items_all_raw.summary: 2026臺北國際自動化工業大展今年聚焦AI、智慧製造與工業5.0，在機器人應用方面，Nvidia近年積極推動的Physical AI成為展出的焦點，如臺達電、所羅門業者展示相關的應用發展。 過去工業用的機器人強調自動化，依照固定程式執行重複作業，Nvidia推動的Physical AI技術，強調機器人結合AI模型、視覺感知及數位孿生，使其具備理解環境、自主規畫、執行任務與持續學習能力。今年自動化展出的內容可看到3項趨勢，包括「數位孿生協助產線規畫及Physical AI落地的重要基礎，「AI Vision成為Physical AI的感知能力」，以及「工廠逐步從自動化走向自主化」。

items_all_raw.title: G7資安職缺AI技能需求倍增，提示與情境工程、AI代理協調成常見核心能力
items_all_raw.summary: G7國家的資安徵才正加速納入AI技能要求。由思科（Cisco）等科技與人才發展業者組成的AI Workforce Consortium分析近兩年職缺變化發現，2025年10月至2026年3月，要求AI技能的資安職缺佔比平均達28.5%，是一年前同期14.2%的2倍。G7是全球七大工業國集團，成員包括：加拿大、法國、德國、義大利、日本、英國、美國。

items_all_raw.title: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale
items_all_raw.summary: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale Promptwatch is part of the emerging "GEO" space, for Generative Engine Optimization - the chatbot version of SEO, where companies offer tools and consulting to help your site increase its presence in replies to prompts inside tools like ChatGPT. The Promptwatch product uses automation to track responses to prompts across end-user chat products like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. They publish aggregate reports on this as part of their own content marketing strategy, which do seem to provide credible hints as to otherwise invisible design changes to those products. Their own tracking shows a notable change aligned with the GPT-5.6 rollout earlier this month: The percentage of all ChatGPT Search fanout queries that contain the site:operator, per day. The share hovered between 0.3% and 0.5% for weeks, dipped briefly to 0.15% on August 3 to 5 (consistent with a staged rollout or pre-launch experiment), then jumped to 16-17% on August 8. It's important to note that these figures only reflect the prompts for which they have automated tracking enabled. This corresponds to OpenAI's somewhat vague August 6th announcement : For Plus and Pro users, we’re updating GPT‑5.6 Sol in Chat to be more reliable with facts and provide more focused answers. Once again I am hampered by OpenAI's decision to actively obscure their system prompts, but from poking at ChatGPT I believe their latest search tool has a shape like search(query, recency, domains) rather than encouraging a site: operator directly. In a follow-up on August 18th Promptwatch repo
items_all_raw.summary_zh: ChatGPT 搜尋現在使用 site:operator 大規模 Promptwatch 是新興“GEO”空間的一部分，用於生成引擎最佳化（SEO 的聊天機器人版本），公司提供工具和諮詢來幫助您的網站在回覆 ChatGPT 等工具內的提示時提高其存在感。 Promptwatch 產品使用自動化技術來跟蹤 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 等終端使用者聊天產品的提示響應。他們釋出了有關此問題的彙總報告，作為自己的內容營銷策略的一部分，這似乎確實為這些產品的其他隱形設計更改提供了可靠的提示。他們自己的跟蹤顯示了與本月早些時候推出的 GPT-5.6 一致的顯著變化：每天包含 site:operator 的所有 ChatGPT 搜尋扇出查詢的百分比。該份額連續數週徘徊在 0.3% 至 0.5% 之間，8 月 3 日至 5 日短暫下跌至 0.15%（與分階段推出或釋出前實驗一致），然後在 8 月 8 日躍升至 16-17%。值得注意的是，這些數字僅反映了啟用自動跟蹤的提示。這與 OpenAI's 8 月 6 日的公告相對應，有些模糊：對於 Plus 和 Pro 使用者，我們正在更新 Chat 中的 GPT‑5.6 Sol，以便更可靠地提供事實並提供更有針對性的答案。我再次受到 OpenAI's 決定主動模糊其系統提示的阻礙，但透過戳 ChatGPT，我相信他們最新的搜尋工具具有類似搜尋（查詢、新近度、域）的形狀，而不是直接鼓勵 site: 操作員。在 8 月 18 日 Promptwatch 回購協議的後續行動中

items_all_raw.summary: PDFs are easy to read and hard to change. AI can now summarize a 90-page contract in seconds, but it still won't rewrite the source file cleanly. UPDF is built for that second half: direct editing, 14-format conversion, 38-language OCR, and ten AI agents shipped in version 2.5. The post Meet UPDF: A Lightweight Adobe Alternative Built for the Agentic Era appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items_all_raw.title: LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable
items_all_raw.summary: LLMs don't write in a recognizable style because they can't do better. Post-training and safety guardrails sharply narrow their expressive range, argues Pangram CTO Bradley Emi. Base models without these constraints already write with far more variety. The article LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: LLMs 不以可識別的風格編寫，因為他們無法做得更好。 Pangram 技術長 Bradley Emi 認為，訓練後和安全護欄大大縮小了它們的表達範圍。沒有這些限制的基本模型已經可以編寫出更多樣的內容。文章 LLMs 可以像人類一樣寫作，但訓練後護欄使他們的文字可檢測到，首先出現在解碼器上。
